ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity black pixels across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips and scattered central patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters located at the distal lobe tips; scattered white circular focal spots distributed medially; distinct white linear streaks (rake marks) localized in the right central and lower central fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 35-45 degrees; apex depth is partially obscured by water turbulence/splash at the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge; highest complexity and jaggedness detected on the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, maintaining a consistent upward sweep on both lateral lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters forming roughly circular patterns on the distal-most points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel white linear marks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation mapping, particularly prominent on the right-hand lobe and the central lower fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged erosion and potential tissue loss along the distal edge of the right lobe; widespread scratch-pattern scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric serration pattern where the right lobe tip exhibits a significantly more 'shredded' contour compared to the left lobe tip.
